title: Condition size
statement: For an expression, define its size recursively: a constant has size equal to the length of its binary digit list, where the empty list has length $1$ and each digit contributes $1$ plus another $1$ if it is nonzero; a variable has size $2$, a binary operation has size the sum of its operands’ sizes plus $1$, and a load has size its operand’s size plus $1$. The size of a less-than condition is the sum of its two expressions’ sizes plus $3$, while the size of an equality condition is that sum plus $4$.
